purpose: Make the remaining A2 Phase1/Phase2 and A4 issue stop-go rules executable before protected results, preserving negative/null outcomes without post-hoc gate changes.

A2_P12_SCIENCEAGENTBENCH.headline_gate: >=3 normalized-point family gain + family-bootstrap lower>0 + domain/LODO direction + max regret<=2

A2_P11_LONGMEMEVAL.headline_gate: positive-quality bootstrap OR >=2x charged-resource saving at <=2pp quality noninferiority; then no benchmark loss >5pp and modelxbenchmark stability

A4_HIDDEN_CAUSE.headline_gate: >=5pp final-success gain + task-bootstrap lower>0 + regret<=0.5x fixed + less false compute + >=75% domain direction + replication + no leakage

global_rules: candidate/strongest baseline identities are frozen on development before protected scoring
hindsight/intervention oracle never enters the primary candidate comparison
all named required arms remain in result packets even when not used in the headline contrast
CANNOT_CHECK or missing broad-scope cells cannot be coerced into a passing gate
negative/null/heterogeneous/replication-negative/leakage-invalid results are terminal for the current preregistration
